dedupe_keys.name: form eia 860 annual electric generator report generator level inventory of existing planned and retired us generators

description: Form EIA-860, the Annual Electric Generator Report of the U.S. Energy Information Administration, collects generator-level information on existing and planned generators and associated environmental equipment at electric power plants with 1 megawatt or more of combined nameplate capacity. The detailed data files give utility, plant and generator records, with generator tabs for operable, proposed, and retired and cancelled units, and extra files for wind, solar and energy storage generators, with a layout file explaining every field. Since 2013 data the survey also collects construction cost data for new generators. Final 2025 data were released on 10 September 2026, with early 2026 data expected in June 2027; older files include the predecessor forms EIA-860A and EIA-860B from 1990. Coverage is all US plants at or above the 1 MW threshold. Files are zipped Excel workbooks, free to download; as US government works they are in the public domain and EIA asks for acknowledgement. Caveats: the retired tab lists only units retired in the latest cycle, and the monthly generator inventory is the place for a full retirement history. Simulation uses are power plant inventories for capacity expansion and dispatch models and exposure of plants to hazards. Related records: data-pudl cleans and joins EIA-860 with other EIA and FERC data, and data-eia-923-power-plant-operations covers generation and fuel.
